title: Sorting the timeline: Varsity Show, Joe Glaser and Chez Maurice
summary: Nierenberg tries to place Europe after Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show; Bubbles says Glaser, Louis Armstrong's manager, booked the Canadian club job.
